fact: On 25 November 2025 the Ministry of Economy, Planning and Development presented its 2026-2030 information system master plan, whose diagnosis found multiple non-interconnected platforms and ageing infrastructure and which proposes professionalising the IT function, with 44 projects budgeted at CFA 10.156 billion including skills building.
title: Modernisation numérique : le Ministère restitue son Schéma Directeur du Système d'Information 2026–2030
publisher: Ministère de l'Économie, du Plan et du Développement
